# ABYSSAL (16 · abyssal)

A deep-sea institute where scrolling is descending — live depth meter, darkening zones, glowing fauna.

- **Technique:** SCROLL DESCENT
- **Tags:** ocean, science, storytelling, scroll, research, deep, blue, nonprofit
- **Best for:** research institutes; nonprofits & conservation; long-form storytelling
- **Fonts:** Gruppo, Albert Sans
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Gruppo&family=Albert+Sans:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #0a5568 · #54e0e8 · #01070c
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/abyssal/` (Template.astro, content.ts, creatures.ts, depth.ts, meta.ts, sea.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* abyssal — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --bg: #03222b;
  --ink: #021118;
  --glow: #54e0e8;
  --glow2: #7ff0c9;
  --violet: #9c7ff0;
  --tx: #dff5f7;
  --dim: #8fb6bd;
  --faint: #4a6d75;
  --scroll-thumb: #0d3b46;

  /* Water column: the fixed background gradient, shallow (1) to deepest (6). */
  --sea-1: #0a5568;
  --sea-2: #064050;
  --sea-3: #03222b;
  --sea-4: #021118;
  --sea-5: #01070c;
  --sea-6: #000305;
  /* Height the gradient is stretched over while scrolling (read by depth.ts). */
  --sea-span: 5200px;

  --ray: #7edce6;
  --hull: #3d6b78;
  --hull-fill: #0a1e28;
  --bone: #e8fbff;

  --disp: "Gruppo", sans-serif;
  --body: "Albert Sans", sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `creatures.ts`
  - `creatures(els: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Fill every `[data-creature]` element with its animated SVG drawing, colored from theme tokens.
- `depth.ts`
  - `scrollProgress()` — Page scroll position as 0–1 (0 when the page is not scrollable).
  - `depthMeter({ read, fill, bg }: DepthMeterEls)` — Drive the depth readout, fill bar and background gradient from scroll progress. Reads `data-max` (depth at page bottom) and `data-unit` from the readout element.
- `sea.ts`
  - `sea(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Fixed full-window canvas: drifting plankton whose glow strengthens with depth, plus light rays near the surface that fade out as the page scrolls down.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<br>/<a> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Which animated SVG creature a zone shows. */
export type Creature = 'jelly' | 'angler' | 'siphon';

export interface Zone {
  /** Section anchor id (nav links target `#${id}`). */
  id: string;
  /** Small glowing label above the heading, e.g. "— 200M · TWILIGHT ZONE". */
  depthLabel: string;
  headingHtml: string;
  bodyHtml: string;
  /** Italic "field note" callout with a glowing left rule. */
  fact: string;
  creature: Creature;
  /** Put the creature on the left and the copy on the right (desktop). */
  flip?: boolean;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Wordmark in nav + footer; wrap the accented letter in <b>. */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  nav: Link[];
  /** Depth meter fixed to the right edge; reading = scroll progress × `max`. */
  depth: {
    /** Depth at the bottom of the page. */
    max: number;
    /** Unit shown after the number, e.g. "M". */
    unit: string;
  };
  hero: {
    /** Pill above the heading. */
    zoneTag: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    subHtml: string;
    /** "Begin descent" link below the hero copy. */
    descend: Link;
  };
  /** One section per depth zone, in descending order. */
  zones: Zone[];
  /** Closing call-to-action section at the bottom of the page. */
  trench: {
    id: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    body: string;
    cta: Link;
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
}
```
